actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 412 - 11 (Roll no. 136). (text: 5/19/2025 CR H2113-2114)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 412 - 11 (Roll no. 136). (text: 5/19/2025 CR H2113-2114)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H2168)

At the conclusion of debate, the chair put the question on the motion to suspend the rules. Mr. Babin objected to the vote on the grounds that a quorum was not present. Further proceedings on the motion were postponed. The point of no quorum was considered as withdrawn.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1223.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H2113-2115)
Mr. Fong moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Ordered to be Reported by Voice Vote.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies, research universities, and laboratories operating members of the U.S. Academic Research Fleet.
dimensions.evidence: head of any university or laboratory that owns or operates a vessel of the U.S. Academic Research Fleet

dimensions.assessment: Requires comprehensive assessments and potential upgrades to shipboard networks, cybersecurity, and spending plans, but is primarily a planning and reporting mandate.
dimensions.evidence: plan to improve the cybersecurity and telecommunications of the U.S. Academic Research Fleet

dimensions.assessment: Involves assessing equipment, software, and personnel costs and creating a spending plan, but does not itself appropriate new federal funds.
dimensions.evidence: an assessment of the costs necessary to meet the needs described in paragraphs (1) and (2)

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific federal agencies to create and report on a targeted administrative and technological improvement plan.
dimensions.evidence: the Director, in consultation with other Federal agency owners... shall submit... a plan to improve

dimensions.assessment: Mandates specific reports due within 18 months and two years, with ongoing potential implementation effects for research vessels.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 18 months after the date of the enactment of this Act... submit... a plan

missing_information: Specific funding amounts allocated for future upgrades
importance_detail.rationale: The ANCHOR Act requires a federal plan to improve cybersecurity and telecommunications for the U.S. Academic Research Fleet within 18 months, followed by an implementation progress report two years later. Its direct operational and planning effects are limited to federal agencies, research laboratories, and university fleets.
